title: 黄仁勋重返英伟达 国会听证与治理争议升温
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Jensen got his job back this week, and this has happened since we last spoke to you.
segments.zh: 黄仁勋本周官复原职，自上次采访后发生了这些事。

segments.en: So when we look back on this week, will we say it was a good one or a bad one for AI?
segments.zh: 回顾本周，对AI来说是好事还是坏事？

segments.en: Well, for NVIDIA as a company, it is definitely the case that Jensen Wong designed this company as his race car, super car, with him as the driver. So you can understand the board's position
segments.zh: 对英伟达而言，黄仁勋把公司设计成他的赛车，自己当车手。所以董事会认为公司需要他掌舵。

segments.en: that the company needs him at the helm. But think about the broader sense of the US economy, the foundations of what has made America such a dynamic economy for hundreds of years.
segments.zh: 但放眼美国经济，美国数百年来充满活力的根基之一，就是合理的公司治理标准。

segments.en: And part of that is having a reasonable standard of corporate governance. And what we have right now, when you see standards and pores looking at a potential NVIDIA downgrade, they're saying how
segments.zh: 如今标准普尔考虑下调英伟达评级，质疑其治理水平。

segments.en: is this company run? And Jensen Wong coming this back and saying he needs no succession plan.
segments.zh: 黄仁勋回归后表示不需要继任计划。

segments.en: Well, you might need a succession plan because even though the vice president says that Huang is not personally under investigation, the reality is that Congress is looking into NVIDIA,
segments.zh: 但你可能需要继任计划，因为尽管副总统称黄仁勋本人未被调查，国会和SEC都在调查英伟达。

segments.en: the SEC is looking into NVIDIA, and the investigations into so many of NVIDIA's customers, not least of which mega speed, the former CEO of whom was the affair in question, the alleged
segments.zh: 对英伟达众多客户的调查也在进行，尤其是Megaspeed，其前CEO正是涉事者，被指为中国间谍。

segments.en: Chinese spy, all of these investigations are going to go forward. And so the idea that there is not some additional shoe to drop after all of the bombshell news that has come out over the past
segments.zh: 所有这些调查都将推进。过去几周爆出重磅消息后，很难说不会再有后续。

segments.en: few weeks, it's really tough to see how this decision makes sense. Well, that's really interesting
segments.zh: 这个决定很难说得通。这确实很有意思。
